summary: Evaxion A/S filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing new biomarker data from its phase 2 trial of personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 in advanced melanoma. The data show detection of neoantigen-specific T cells directly ex vivo and are scheduled for oral and poster presentations at the SITC 2026 Annual Meeting in Phoenix, Arizona, on the meeting dates. No transaction, ownership stake, price per share, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing is a clinical/scientific update only. No deal terms are stated.
